newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Transpaco surges on strong profit growth.
newsitem.headline: Transpaco surges on strong profit growth.

text.p: Shares in Transpaco Ltd, a South African paper, plastic and packaging materials firm, leapt in busy morning dealings adding almost 50 percent to their value after the firm posted robust year earnings earlier.
At 0924 GMT Transpaco soared 50 cents to a fresh high of 150 cents, making it the biggest percentage gainer on the Johannesburg bourse on Thursday.
Dealers said the usually thinly traded share had come to life after the group posted a 33 percent improvement in year attributable share earnings to 20 cents.
"There are a whole mixed bag of dealers in the share," one trader said.

Transpaco did not declare a dividend saying its recent expansion required substantial capital nd although no major expenditure was expected in the future, it was considered prudent not make a cash payment to shareholders.
It said it was budgeting for a substantial improvement in results for the current financial year and expected to declare a dividend at the end of the year.
